'''Abalen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who worked as a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] vendor on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
